output_list.criticism: The initialSupply is multiplied by 10 ** uint256(decimals) without any overflow check. If initialSupply is too large, it will cause an integer overflow.
The balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value operations are not checked for overflow. If _value is too large, it will cause an integer overflow.
The balanceOf[target] += mintedAmount and totalSupply += mintedAmount operations are not checked for overflow. If mintedAmount is too large, it will cause an integer overflow.
The _transfer function is not restricted to onlyOwner, allowing any address to transfer tokens. This can be exploited by malicious actors to transfer tokens from other addresses.
The mintToken function is onlyOwner, allowing only the contract owner to mint tokens. This can be exploited by malicious actors to mint tokens to any address.
